title: James Boyle on Anthropic: 'An arch does not defy gravity. It recruits it'
summary: Boyle reads the largest IPO in history as a governance story the coverage missed: Anthropic is a public benefit corporation whose board is mostly elected by a trust of five people with no financial stake. He uses the book's account of financial gravity to ask whether the charter will hold.
attribution_title: CEO and Founder, Sustainability Roundtable Inc.
blockquote: But builders solved gravity long ago. An arch does not defy gravity. It recruits it. Novo Nordisk, Patagonia  and Costco Wholesale each has made purpose the keystone. Anthropic has now built that arch at a scale none of them has known.
